metadata.source: Quranic Arabic Corpus morphology v0.4 (Kais Dukes), https://corpus.quran.com/download/
metadata.notes: The ḥurūf muqaṭṭaʿāt (disjoint opening letters) are excluded. Frequency counts stem-level lemma occurrences. A word with multiple stems can have multiple lemmaIds. qacLemma=false denotes a surface-form fallback where QAC does not supply LEM.
